## 1. Biography & Academic Standing

Abdul Hanan Irfan (professionally **Hanan Irfan**) is a Multidisciplinary Developer, SEO Specialist, and Entrepreneur based in Rahim Yar Khan, Pakistan. He is currently in the **5th Semester of BS Computer Science (BSCS)** at **Khwaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology (KFUEIT)**, maintaining a **3.65 CGPA** and holding the **Faculty of IT Dean's Honor Certificate (Spring 2026)**.

Leadership roles:
1. **Founder & AI Developer — The Sports Room** (2026–Present, co-founded with Urwah Farooq under HI Digital Group)
2. **Development Team Head — ACM KFUEIT** (2025–Present, ACM Student Chapter at KFUEIT)
3. **Ambassador of D'Educationist @ KFUEIT** (2025–Present)
4. **Full-Stack Developer, SEO Specialist & Digital Consultant** (2023–Present, HI Digital Group & Independent)

## 2. Deployed Projects & Software Products (11 Live Builds)

1. **The Sports Room** (`https://thesportsroom.online`) — Independent digital sports media and analytics platform co-founded by Hanan Irfan and Urwah Farooq under HI Digital Group. Built with AI-assisted workflows, technical SEO, AEO/GEO schemas, cricket telemetry, tactical breakdowns, daily quizzes, and fan leaderboards.
2. **NEXA POS System** (`https://nexapossystem.vercel.app/`) — Full-stack retail POS and business management SaaS built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PWA offline resilience, inventory low-stock alerts, customer CRM, ledgers, and sales analytics charts.
3. **ACM KFUEIT** (`https://acm-kfueit.vercel.app/`) — Official web portal for the ACM KFUEIT Student Chapter supporting campus technical events, announcements, and student developer showcases.
4. **Free Tools Hub** (`https://freetoolshub1.vercel.app/`) — Privacy-first browser-based developer utilities suite (JSON Formatter & Validator, Base64 Encoder/Decoder, Image Compressor/Resizer, Text Case & Word Counter, Password/UUID Generator, Color Picker).
5. **AI Tool Guide** (`https://aitoolguide.vercel.app/`) — Curated AI platforms discovery platform structured by workflow, prompt pattern, and practical use-case.
6. **HI Digital Group** (`https://hidigitalgroup.vercel.app/`) — Digital engineering and search consulting portal covering React/Next.js builds, technical SEO, AEO & GEO.
7. **Hanan Irfan Portfolio** (`https://hanan56.vercel.app/`) — Official multi-page PWA and Bubblewrap Android TWA portfolio (`com.hananirfan.app`) featuring Schema.org JSON-LD, Web Push / FCM notifications, and responsive design.
8. **Caesar 2026** (`https://caesar2026.vercel.app/`) — Frontend UI layout & typographic hierarchy web project.
9. **Garden Layout Tips** (`https://gardenlayouttips.vercel.app/`) — Search-engineered content architecture & keyword-clustered informational site.
10. **Punch Monkey** (`https://punchmonkey.vercel.app/`) — Interactive HTML5 Canvas 2D pointer/touch physics experiment.
11. **AI Course by Hanan Irfan** (`https://aicoursebyhananirfan.vercel.app/`) — Educational web resource covering foundational AI and prompt engineering patterns.

## 3. Technical Stack & Core Competencies

- **AI Development**: AI Application Development, Prompt Engineering & Workflows, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Python & Automation Scripting.
- **Frontend & Full-Stack**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, PWA / Service Workers / Web Push.
- **SEO, AEO, GEO & Content**: Technical SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD graphs, XML Sitemaps, Robots/AI Crawler configuration, Keyword Research & Clustering, Content Strategy, Google Search Console diagnostics.
- **Programming & Databases**: C++, Java, SQL, Firebase (Firestore, Auth, FCM), Supabase (PostgreSQL), WordPress / Astra CMS performance tuning.
- **Design & Platforms**: UI/UX wireframing, Figma, Canva, Photoshop, Git, GitHub, Vercel edge hosting, Bubblewrap Android TWA (`com.hananirfan.app`).
